question: Which holy places and rivers in this world are invoked as present with that marked person?
premises: Holy places in this world are invoked
Gaṅgā and other rivers are invoked
These are associated with the previously described person
inference: All holy places and rivers such as the Gaṅgā are present with the person bearing those sacred marks.
uncertainties: The explicit predicate equating these holy places with the person is implied but not fully stated in this verse.
plain_english: Whatever holy places there are in this world, and whatever rivers such as the Gaṅgā.
